Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA . Our goal is to give people their agency back . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity . The role Syd is looking for an Operations Manager , reporting to the CEO , to make sure every client delivery and company project is planned , tracked and delivered on time . You will set one consistent project management standard across the company and turn direction into plans , owners and dates .
